words.prose: {{ar:قِسْمَةٌ}} ({{tr:qismatun}}) is the predicate noun that names what the prior arrangement is: a division, an apportioning, a classification. After the pointer and consequence particle, this is the noun where the inference lands, and its tanwin answers the particle's nasal close. Its indefiniteness makes the judgment qualitative, as though the claim is being placed under a type of division rather than identified as one known division. The following adjective binds unfairness to the division itself, so the condemnation does not float loose from the allocation noun. The preceding split in 53:21 selects the allocation sense, while the wider classification pressure prepares the next critique of names (53:23). The root family also includes oath and lot-seeking branches, but those remain narrowed background contrasts here; the local surface is a noun of the produced allocation, not an oath act or a divination procedure. Its relative rarity and its recurrence in allocation contexts such as 54:28 and 43:32 make the word feel deliberately chosen where the argument turns on apportionment.

words.prose: {{ar:ضِيزَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ḍīzā}}) supplies the evaluative seal: the division is not merely named but condemned as skewed, unjust, and deficient. The adjective is strongly bound to {{ar:قِسْمَةٌ}} ({{tr:qismatun}}), though the nominative shape can also let the unfairness sound like an added verdict: that is a division, and it is skewed. Its root image joins moral wrong, physical tilt, and curtailed share, so the word makes the allocation feel like an unbalanced structure rather than a generic bad choice. The canonical form is also marked: rare, formally odd in its vowel profile, and acoustically rough through emphatic onset, high vowel, buzzing fricative, and open ending. Variant readings keep the root and sound analysis alive as apparatus, including a possible arrested internal sound, but the local verdict remains the same. As the final word, with a lingering long ending that answers the feminine endpoint in 53:21, it makes skewedness the ayah's last audible impression.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قِسْمَةٌ at word 3 is directly qualified by ضِيزَىٰ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus first separates something into shares, then marks the allocation as deficient, rights-diminishing, and unjust. The predicate condemns both the resulting proportions and the deprivation enacted through them.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning a thing into separated shares supplies the concrete distributive operation under judgment.
A deficient and unjust division that withholds a right supplies both the verdict and the injury.

changed_reading.after: The allotment is condemned because its shares are deficient and somebody's due is withheld.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of قِسْمَةٌ at word 3 also carries inward estimation, while ضِيزَىٰ at word 4 evaluates the result.
baseline_models.mechanism: The division can coexist as an inward sorting of possible courses. On this reading, the defect lies upstream in a mind that estimates alternatives through a biased partition, not only downstream in distributed goods.

activation_trace.role: A mind divided among courses supplies an internal deliberative partition as the focus mechanism.
Deficiency and injustice in judgment mark that deliberative partition as biased rather than neutral.

changed_reading.before: The phrase criticizes an external split.
changed_reading.after: It can also indict the evaluative sorting that made the split appear acceptable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قِسْمَةٌ at word 3 can activate the root's oath-allocation and qasama procedure, while ضِيزَىٰ at word 4 includes injustice in judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A juridical resonance coexists with ordinary apportionment: sworn responsibility or a settlement procedure has been arranged to produce a partial verdict. This is form-distant but focus-rooted.

activation_trace.role: An oath apportioned among its holders and the qasama proceeding supply a procedural legal frame.
Unjust judgment and diminished right make the legal resonance a compromised proceeding rather than mere arithmetic.

changed_reading.before: Only the ratio of an allocation is bad.
changed_reading.after: The procedure that authorizes and certifies the allocation may itself be partial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech can receive hidden knowledge, but the rival sequence follows inclination, conjecture, and a wish pictured by the heart. These cues strengthen the inward baseline: preference first ranks reality into desirable shares, then speech presents that ranking as an allocation.

activation_trace.role: A mind divided among courses anchors the changed reading in the focus as an act of evaluative sorting.
The deficient judgment names the bias produced by that sorting.
Literal speaking supplies the output channel whose source is being contrasted.
Knowledge cast secretly supplies the non-preferential source opposed to self-generated ranking.
The soul's inclination supplies preference as an upstream allocator.
Doubt and supposition supply the weak evidentiary material from which the preferred shares are constructed.
A wish pictured by the heart supplies the imagined entitlement that preference converts into a share.

structural_cues: 53:3-4 contrasts desire-sourced speech with received disclosure.
53:23-24 sequences conjecture, inward inclination, guidance, and wished-for possession immediately after the focus.

A live alternative is that these cues rebut belief formation without redescribing the mechanics of qisma.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a badly proportioned external division.
changed_reading.after: The division is the visible output of an epistemic machine in which desire ranks the options and conjecture certifies the preferred share.

context_deltas.mechanism: Equality, comparison by a measure, and deviation from a straight line turn the focus into a failed-calibration verdict. The allocation is dyza because the comparator, balance, or line by which shares should correspond has been bent.

activation_trace.role: Separated shares provide the quantities whose correspondence must be tested.
Deficient apportionment supplies the failed result of the test.
Equality between two things supplies the calibration norm for comparing shares.
Estimating one thing by another supplies an explicit measuring operation.
Departure from straightness supplies the image of a measure or judgment bending off line.

structural_cues: 53:6-9 moves through becoming level, proximity, and measured span.
53:17 negates visual deviation before 53:21-22 exposes a deviating allocation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equality, measurement, and non-deviation; I infer that they furnish a procedural norm for the later distribution. The alternative is that these belong only to the vision scene and do not govern the social logic of the focus.

changed_reading.before: Dyza means morally unfair in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: Dyza can diagnose a measurement failure: the allocator chose a bent comparator and therefore produced non-corresponding shares.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate male/female allocation is later answered by creation of the two as a joined pair. Qisma now appears as a severing operation: it extracts the socially preferred pole for the speakers and assigns the devalued pole elsewhere, breaking a created relation into prestige shares.

activation_trace.role: Separating and allotting shares anchors the severing of a relational pair in the focus.
Diminishing a right identifies the prestige-loaded reassignment as the injustice.
The male opposed to the female supplies one pole selected as the speakers' share.
The female opposed to the male supplies the other pole assigned away from the speakers.
Bringing creation into being removes both poles from the speakers' proprietary control.
One counterpart joined to its counterpart restores male and female as a relation before they are rival shares.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns an unequal allocation between two owners.
changed_reading.after: It condemns the prior act of tearing a pair into ranked identities and appropriating the prestigious identity as one's own share.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-applied names provide denotation but no compelling authority, while later efficacy waits for permission. These cues strengthen the procedural baseline: the allocation is defective before its ratio is examined because its authors lack standing to name the parties, assign the shares, or ratify the settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later accounting matches action to recompense, refuses transfer of a burden, limits a person to acquired striving, and pays fully without deficiency. Work, earning, and disposal supply the personal basis on which a share is credited.

structural_cues: 53:31 links recompense to what people did.
53:38-41 sequences non-transferable burden, personal striving, visible result, and fullest recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four accounting constraints; I infer that they are a distributed countermodel to the focus verdict. The alternative is that eschatological recompense is a separate topic rather than an explanation of what makes the earlier qisma unjust.

changed_reading.before: The focus mocks one locally unfair ratio.
changed_reading.after: It names an anti-accounting system: benefits and liabilities are assigned by preference and identity instead of action, non-transferability, and full settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command not to purify the self and the repeated location of knowledge outside the self turn the deliberative qisma inward. A person can make a dyza division by placing the self in the clean, entitled class and exporting deficiency to others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving, smallness, and a gift cut off at a hard obstruction make deficiency temporal. A share becomes dyza not only when initially unequal but when an allotment begins, is reduced to little, and is then withheld.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning a share anchors the promised or initiated transfer in the focus.

structural_cues: 53:34 is a three-step verbal sequence: gave, little, then stopped.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gift that becomes little and stops; I map that sequence back as a micro-model of dyza deprivation. The alternative is that 53:34 portrays a separate failure of generosity rather than explaining the focus allocation.

changed_reading.before: The unfairness is a static snapshot of unequal shares.
changed_reading.after: The unfairness can unfold through time as an initiated share is pared down and finally cut off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the face-beauty branch of ق س م is distant from the ordinary noun قِسْمَةٌ. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قِسْمَةٌ at word 3 can evoke beauty apportioned across a face, while ضِيزَىٰ at word 4 makes that arrangement deficient and crooked.

activation_trace.role: Beauty apportioned across the face supplies a visible arrangement whose harmony can succeed or fail.
Deficiency and injustice turn the visible arrangement into an asymmetrical evaluative face.
A face spreading until its teeth show supplies the later bodily display of valuation.

Lowering and bending the head supplies the final bodily reversal of that posture.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an abstract verdict on allocation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the allocation has a face: preference composes a visibly asymmetrical expression that the final lowering of the head reverses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cloth-folding branch is isolated and form-distant. It remains valid as a focus-rooted material analogy sharpened by later uncovering; downstream prose should call it a compositional model of propagated classification, not a lexical sense asserted for the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of قِسْمَةٌ at word 3 includes the first fold of cloth, and ضِيزَىٰ at word 4 can qualify that initiating fold as defective.

activation_trace.role: The cloth-maker's first fold supplies an initiating crease that governs how later layers align.
Deficiency and injustice make the initiating crease one that propagates misalignment.

changed_reading.before: The condemned division is a finished result.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a bad first fold: an initial classificatory crease that makes subsequent layers align wrongly until they are uncovered.

strongest_changes: Desire, conjecture, and wishing become upstream allocators rather than mere motives after the division.
Self-naming without authority or permission makes the partition jurisdictionally void before its ratio is tested.
Action-matched, non-transferable, fully paid recompense supplies a positive accounting system whose inverse is qisma dyza.
The little gift that stops turns static inequality into a temporal mechanism of withholding.
summary.what_was_special: The singleton ض ي ز branch behaves as a compact diagnostic operator while the wider ق س م inventory keeps distributive, deliberative, procedural, material, and embodied readings live together. Context does not choose one domain; it reveals the same biased partition recurring across belief, status, authority, accounting, and posture.
remaining_uncertainties: The oath and legal-procedure resonance is root-valid but may be too form-distant to carry beyond exploratory prose.
The created-pair reading depends on an inferred prestige asymmetry; a narrower contradiction-reading remains live.
The face and first-fold outliers are branch-driven metaphors and must not be rendered as lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **An allocation that diminishes a right.** ق س م B003 supplies apportioning into shares; ض ي ز B001 supplies a deficient, unjust division that withholds or reduces a right. The demonstrative points back to 53:21's asymmetric assignment. I infer that the defect lies in the allocator's own unequal valuation; the ayah reads as a compact adjudication of their scheme.
2. **A divided mind behind the division.** ق س م B006 supplies a mind divided between courses. The prior preference and later claim that these are only names (53:23) suggest a split between professed reverence and actual contempt. I infer that incoherent valuation produces incoherent apportionment; *qismah* can expose deliberative fracture as well as material division.
3. **Beauty is not the measure.** ق س م B001 supplies facial beauty or harmonious looks, while ض ي ز B001 denies just proportion. Exploratorily, I infer that a seemingly neat symmetrical assignment (“male/female”) lacks genuine harmony because its values are unequal. The ayah reads as rejecting cosmetic balance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:31 and 53:41 later present ج ز ي B001 and و ف ي B001 as matching, full settlement. Against that complete accounting, this division's ض ي ز B001 deficiency becomes a negative image of judgment itself.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, güzelliği özellikle yüzde görülen bir nitelik olarak verir; hem soyut güzellik adlarını hem de güzel yüzlü kişi ve yüz betimlemelerini kapsar. Bu nedenle dalın yüz güzelliği ekseni kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, malı bölme, yemin etme, öğle sıcağı ve öteki eşsesli anlamları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın güzellik adlarıyla yüzü niteleyen kalıpları ayırır; kalıba bağlı kişi nitelemelerini bütün dalın tek biçimi saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Yüzde ya da kişinin görünüşünde beliren güzellik ve yüz güzelliği niteliğidir. Bazı kullanımlar doğrudan güzel yüzü, bazıları da böyle bir yüze sahip kişiyi niteler.

facets.statement: Yüzde veya insan görünüşünde algılanan güzellik niteliğini bildirir.
Güzel yüzün kendisini ya da güzel yüzlü kişiyi niteleyen kullanımları kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu anlam alanında güzelliği ve yüz güzelliğini ortak çekirdek olarak verir; ad ve niteleme biçimleri güzel yüzü veya güzel yüzlü kişiyi anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın soyut güzellik çekirdeğini ve güzelliğin özellikle yüzde görünmesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzle ilişkili güzellik niteliğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiyi yüzünün güzelliğiyle niteleyen kullanımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin yüz güzelliğini ve olumlu görünüşünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Soyut güzellik adı olarak kullanılabilme yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğrudan yüzün kendisinin güzel diye nitelendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güzelliğin yüzde gerçekleşmesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin bütünü için kullanılan niteleme ve soyut nitelik adı kapsamını kaybeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir noktada birleşmez: bir aktarım sözcüğü öğle sıcağının şiddeti, diğeri ise bu sıcağın görüldüğü vakit olarak açıklar. Dal korunabilir, ancak hem yoğunluk hem zaman okuması açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, genel sıcaklığa değil özellikle gün ortasındaki şiddetli sıcağa veya onun vaktine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı kapsar ve başka dallardaki güzellik, bölüştürme ya da yemin anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Gün ortasında bastıran şiddetli sıcak ya da bu sıcağın yaşandığı vakittir. Kaynak anlatımı yoğunluk ile zaman adlandırmasını yan yana bırakır.

facets.statement: Gün ortasında hissedilen şiddetli sıcağı bildirir.
Aynı söz, şiddetli öğle sıcağının yaşandığı vakti de adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, sözü bir yandan şiddetli öğle sıcağına, öte yandan bu sıcağın vaktine bağlar; bu iki okuma tek bir yoğun gün ortası sahnesinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynaklardaki sıcaklık yoğunluğu ile gün ortası zamanı okumalarının ikisini de açıkça taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Şiddetli sıcak ile onun gün ortasındaki vakit değerini birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: Sözcüğün doğrudan bir vakti adlandırabildiği okumasını kaybeder.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün günün sıcak bir zaman dilimini adlandırdığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir bütünü parçalara veya hak sahiplerine ayırma işlemini, bu işlemle belirlenen payı ve paylaşmaya katılan kişiyi birlikte verir. Dalın işlem ve sonuç ayrımı bu içeriği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yemin etmeyi ve payın ok çekerek aranmasını değil gerçek bölme, dağıtma ve belirlenmiş payı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın bölme ve pay anlamlarını korurken belirli nesne, kişi ve araç kalıplarını bağımlı özel kullanımlar olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi parçalara ya da hak sahiplerinin paylarına ayırma ve dağıtma işlemidir; ayrıca bu işlem sonunda ayrılan payı bildirir. Paylaşmaya katılan kişi ve miras ya da ganimetin sahiplerine dağıtılması bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir bütünü parçalara, kişilere veya belirlenmiş paylara ayırma ve dağıtma işlemini bildirir.
Ayırma işlemi sonunda bir kimseye düşen belirli payı veya hakkı bildirir.
Birlikte paylaşan kişiyi ve miras ya da savaş kazancının hak sahiplerine dağıtılmasını kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bölme, paylara ayırma ve dağıtma işlemiyle bu işlemden doğan pay üzerinde birleşir; ortaklaşa paylaşan kişi ile miras ve savaş kazancının sahiplerine verilmesi de bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İşlem olarak bölüştürmeyi ve sonuç olarak belirlenen payı aynı kısa karşılıkta korur.

error_profile.preserves: Bölme işlemini, dağıtımı ve bu işlemden doğan payı birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel olarak yemin etmeyi ve bunun özel bir kökeni sayılan, öldürme davasında maktulün yakınlarına dağıtılan yeminleri birlikte açıklar. Dalın genel yemin ile özel hukuk uygulaması ayrımı bu yapıya uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki dağıtma, mal paylaştırma anlamı değil; öldürme davasında yeminlerin ilgililere bölüştürülmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yemin anlamıyla belirli yeminleşme ve öldürme davası kalıplarını ayırır; özel uygulamayı her yeminin zorunlu içeriği yapmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün doğruluğunu güçlü bir tanıklık çağrısıyla güvenceye bağlayarak yemin etmedir. Özel hukuk kullanımında, öldürme iddiasında yeminlerin öldürülen kişinin yakınları arasında paylaştırılmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir iddia veya söz için yemin etmeyi ve karşılıklı yeminleşmeyi bildirir.
Öldürme iddiasında yeminlerin öldürülen kişinin yakınlarına bölüştürüldüğü hukuk uygulamasını kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar genel yemin anlamında birleşir ve bu anlamı, öldürme davasında yeminlerin yakınlara paylaştırıldığı özel uygulamayla ilişkilendirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım açıkça işaretli oklarla kurulan yapıya bağlıdır; aynı türetimin genel olarak paylaştırma isteme kullanımı yalın dal anlamına çevrilmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca işaretli oklarla yapılacak işi veya kişiye ayrılan sonucu belirleme uygulamasını karşılar.
